identification: German-style 'pronk' still life, oil on canvas laid on board, 65 x 52 cm, in a heavy black carved frame with gilt slip: nautilus/gilt cup, Chinese blue-and-white charger, grapes, pears, open book, glass goblet, lacquered cabinet with painted panels, jade figure, picture of a windmill on the wall, lace cloth, and a carved plaque inscribed 'Markgraf Albert...'. Signed lower right faintly 'Aug. Scholz'. Looks 20th century, decorative, after Dutch/German Golden Age models. Some surface dirt, craquelure.
